name: eX=psY-Progress
source:
What is happening!?

I should have been a boy!
But I became a girl!

Since that day, his body comes and goes between two genders. 
A hilarious transsexual comic in school.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041222.html]DLsite English[/url]]

发生什么了！？

我本来应该是男孩！
可我变成了女孩！

从那天起，他的身体在两种性别之间来回变化。
一部发生在校园里的爆笑变性漫画。
